gen-gf-offside-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch is a plain sans with open curves and rod-stock strokes. Offside sits above it, widely tracked and expressive, so a heading around double the body size would let its curves breathe.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-stack-sans-text: Sharp, tall and a bit futuristic: Oxanium draws its monoline strokes with big lowercase and curves that end in clear daylight. And Stack Sans Text carries a marker-like constant line underneath, so paragraphs keep a smooth, even texture.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-sarpanch: Scattered, shouty and loose, Paprika fills each line with lowercase that behaves like capitals. Sarpanch comes in after it, a sans with a clearly open mouth on its e, so a long passage feels approachable and compact.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta is a plain sans with a dominant x-height. Eater looms above it, dark and aggressive, while the body's cut-back terminals keep a long passage clear and contemporary.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Flavors towers with a stubby, pencil-thick x-height and diagonals as heavy as its stems, which feels whimsical. And Noto Sans Ugaritic, a plain sans with open mouths, gives a long passage a friendly, tight-set rhythm.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai reads in solid blocks of words rather than skylines. Autour One adds a heading traced at one thickness, so the pair's strongest quality is how bold and modern it sits together.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Futuristic is the mood Audiowide sets, with tile-like glyphs and a drafting-pen line that never shifts in width. Noto Sans Coptic keeps a long passage clean and dense.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sulphur-point: Goldman spaces its letters wide, with round forms like open parentheses and a big lowercase against its capitals. But Sulphur Point, a plain sans with a marker-like line, makes a long stretch of text feel bulky and open.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi is a plain sans whose e opens clearly to the right, with outsized lowercase. And Grandstander answers it with bars as heavy as its stems, so the pair's strongest quality is a bold, chunky openness.
